title: Setting up a group payment
summary: This document explains how to set up a group payment: prepare up to 30 participants, collect contact details, choose a split method (equal shares, unequal shares via Yes, or percentage-based via Yes), enter/verify shares that reconcile to the total, attach a clear description, confirm details, and send to start tracking responses and payments.
faqs: How many participants can I include in a group payment?
What contact information do I need for each group member?
What split methods are available (equal, unequal, percentage-based) and how do I select them?
How do I add participants and build the share breakdown?
How do I verify that the entered shares/percentages reconcile to the total before sending?
What should I confirm and attach before sending the group payment for tracking?
